title: Alia Syed wins £10,000 Jarman award for ‘depth and maturity’ of her experimental films
summary_full: The Welsh-Indian artist takes this year’s award, an established bellwether for future stars, for work focused on memory, migration and hidden historiesAlia Syed has won this year’s Film London Jarman award, the prestigious UK prize for groundbreaking artist film-makers in the UK.The Welsh-Indian film-maker’s work, which incorporates themes of memory, migration and hidden histories, was praised by judges for its “restless will to play, experiment and change”. Syed will receive £10,000 in prize money. Continue reading...
